subject: Post-call: procurement & security next steps for BrightPath
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Liu <amy@brightpathhealth.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 14:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: procurement & security next steps for BrightPath

Thanks again for your time today — good to meet the BrightPath team. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our end so everyone is aligned:

What we covered
- Scope: hosted Redwood API for secure clinical summarization (sandbox -> prod).
- Usage estimate: ~300k tokens/month initially; likely to scale.
- Security gating items called out by your infosec: SOC 2 evidence, execution of DPA, and a short security questionnaire.

What we agreed (action items)
1) BrightPath to confirm procurement path (PO via net-30 vs credit card vs AWS Marketplace).
2) BrightPath infosec to send questionnaire (or we can send ours) — we flagged SOC 2 / DPA dependencies.
3) Redwood to share concise attestation and DPA draft + commercial proposal.
4) Align on a procurement ops call next week if BrightPath wants to use PO/AWS Marketplace.

Attachments I’m sending with this email:
- Redwood_SA_Attestation.pdf (high level security controls + encryption summary)
- Redwood_DPA_v1.2.docx (editable DPA we typically use)
- pricing-proposal-BP-2026-045.pdf (starter SOW/pricing for hosted API)

Short notes on the security gating you raised
- SOC 2: we are SOC 2 Type II in 2025 and maintain evidence; we have an executive summary and select control artifacts we can provide (see attestation). If you need the full report we typically share under NDA — we can start that flow if needed.
- DPA: editable doc attached; we can incorporate BrightPath standard notices if you send them.
- Questionnaire: happy to run through your spreadsheet — marcus (cc’d) can take point on technical controls and turnaround.

Next suggested dates
- Procurement ops / billing: Wed 3/24 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 3/25 9:00–10:00 PT.

If you confirm the procurement route (PO vs marketplace vs card) we’ll tailor the billing steps and push relevant finance/invoice templates over.

Thanks — looking forward.

—
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Amy Liu <amy@brightpathhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@brightpathhealth.com>, procurement@brightpathhealth.com, infosec@brightpathhealth.com
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement & security next steps for BrightPath

Thanks Soojin — useful recap. A few quick answers from our side:

Procurement path
- Procurement preference: PO via AWS Marketplace would be ideal because our purchasing team can route faster and we get the SaaS contract flow aligned with IT. If Redwood is listed or able to transact via AWS Marketplace that would be our preference. If not, PO net-30 is acceptable.

Security evidence
- Infosec asked whether you can share a SOC 2 interim summary (or executive summary) and the DPA. We’ll review and let you know if we need the full report under NDA.

Questionnaire
- I’ll have our security analyst (cc’d) send over the questionnaire by end of day — if Redwood can pre-populate any answers that’d speed things along.

Procurement/contact
- Procurement inbox: procurement@brightpathhealth.com — Daniel Park is our procurement lead (copied). Billing contact for POs is finance@brightpathhealth.com.

We’d like to schedule the procurement ops call for Thu 3/25 09:00 PT if that still works.

Thanks,
Amy
Director of Product Operations
BrightPath Health
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Liu <amy@brightpathhealth.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@brightpathhealth.com>, procurement@brightpathhealth.com
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, infosec@brightpathhealth.com
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2026 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement & security next steps for BrightPath

Appreciate the quick reply, Amy — marketplace route noted. A couple clarifications and what we’ll bring to Thu 3/25 09:00 PT:

Marketplace vs PO (short)
- AWS Marketplace: yes, Redwood supports AWS Marketplace for hosted API purchases; it accelerates procurement but requires a short setup (listing + contract routing). If BrightPath wants that path, we’ll involve our partnerships team and provide the marketplace SKUs and instructions on the call.
- PO (net-30): standard flow we use today — we can accept PO and send invoice + W9 once contract is signed.

Security artifacts we’ll share before the call
- Redwood_SA_Attestation.pdf (attached earlier) — summarized SOC 2 controls and encryption/KMS details.
- We will provide an SOC 2 executive summary and a scoped set of control artifacts under NDA if needed; happy to start the NDA flow now if Infosec requests.
- DPA: attached editable doc (Redwood_DPA_v1.2.docx). If you have standard clauses please point them out and we’ll review.

Questionnaire handling
- Marcus will pre-populate our responses to any routine control questions (encryption, logging, access controls). For SOC 2-specific controls we’ll reference the attestation and provide planned evidence delivery timelines.

Meeting objective for Thu 3/25 09:00 PT
- Confirm commercial path (Marketplace vs PO) and owner for the Marketplace setup if chosen.
- Agree on billing cadence and PO terms (net-30, invoice details).
- Agree timing for DPA signoff and whether BrightPath needs the full SOC 2 report under NDA.

If procurement prefers an earlier time, we can shift — otherwise we’ll plan for Thu 3/25 09:00 PT. I’ll have pricing-proposal-BP-2026-045.pdf ready and can share marketplace SKU info live.
